title: Abbahu bar Geniva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman calls him a student of Rava. In [Bava Batra 139a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.139a.13), he sent Rava a question beginning “Let our master teach us.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli writes Avuh bar Geniva and has him send the question to Rava. “Our master” is how he addresses Rava.
[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=118&lang=en) gives Abbahu son of Rav Geniva and records the Genuva spelling. Hyman calls him Rava’s student.
